meta.title: Recreate with Evaluation Duration cleared
gaps: Verify that the newly created event closes immediately when bidding ends rather than entering an evaluation window.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the newly created event closes immediately when bidding ends rather than entering an evaluation window.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ's project summary without creating or searching for another event.
Open the stage menu and choose Recreate Order.
Confirm that the Recreate Order popup opened and shows its Product Sheet section.
Confirm the popup includes the expected order configuration section.
Confirm the popup includes the delivery date field before editing it.
Confirm the popup presents the event scheduling choice.

args.goal: in the Recreate Order popup, click Clear under Evaluation Duration, click Create Order, and stop on the newly created event or its create screen showing that no evaluation duration or evaluation window is configured

steps.note: Perform the popup-specific clear and creation actions that no dedicated catalog step can express.
Confirm the resulting screen rendered without an error or crash.
